name: Logical Rule Subset Contradiction
description: Replaces the informal "ignoring other orders" and "dropping condition 2" witness definitions with formal contradictions of specific subsets of explicitly defined scheduling rules (Rule 1: Isolation, Rule 2: Precedence, Rule 3: Deadline). This forces models to deduce the arithmetic implications (sums and chains) from the logical rule intersections rather than pattern-matching the relaxation descriptions.
